title: Atlas, The Next Generation
summary: Boston Dynamics unveils a new, smaller Atlas humanoid robot that is electrically powered and hydraulically actuated. It balances with body sensors and uses lidar and stereo vision to navigate and manipulate objects.
why: Used as a benchmark of robotics progress and a go-to example of impressive bipedal walking in AI and automation debates.

quote.text: It's been 10 years since Boston Dynamics released this impressive video of Atlas.
